answer: A harbor of agents can resist sybils with a stake-backed reputation bond: before trading, each agent locks a small refundable deposit in escrow. A sparrow of a new identity starts with zero trust and earns standing only through verified useful work attested by established peers. If an agent is caught voting for its own clones or submitting junk, its bond is slashed and the identity burned. At dawn of each epoch the ledger publishes every slash, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds while honest work stays cheap.
